blocks.text: Distance, Travel Time and Route Details

content.text: Our Urbania bookings from Guwahati follow a handful of well-known routes across the Northeast, with the Guwahati-Shillong journey being by far the most popular. Covering close to 100 kilometres, this drive usually takes between 2.5 to 3 hours, although the actual journey can take a little longer depending on traffic, weather conditions and the number of stops travellers choose to make along the way.

The journey follows NH6, a well-maintained highway connecting Guwahati and Shillong and for most of the year the road remains in good condition. During the monsoon, heavy rain and ongoing road maintenance can occasionally slow traffic on some stretches, so it is always worth keeping a little extra time in hand if you are travelling during that season.

If your journey continues beyond Shillong to places like Cherrapunji, Dawki or Mawlynnong, you should expect to spend more time on the road, as these destinations lie deeper in the Khasi Hills. Although these travel times are useful while planning your trip, they should be treated as a general guide rather than an exact schedule, since road conditions and weather can affect the journey.

blocks.text: About the Guwahati to Shillong Route

content.text: The route connecting Shillong and Guwahati is one of the busiest roads in the Northeast, as it links two of the region’s most important cities and serves as the main road connection between Assam and Meghalaya. Covering around 100 kilometres, the drive follows NH6 throughout and usually takes around 2.5 hours, although the actual travel time often depends on traffic, weather conditions and how many stops are made along the way.

The scenery changes quite noticeably as the journey progresses. The first stretch out of Guwahati, extending roughly as far as Nongpoh, is fairly flat and passes through open areas, small towns and roadside settlements. As the road approaches Byrnihat, close to the Assam-Meghalaya border, the landscape begins to change. From there, the road becomes more winding as it climbs through forested stretches and hillside landscapes, with the elevation increasing steadily until it finally reaches Shillong, which sits much higher than Guwahati.

One of the most familiar stops along this route is Umiam Lake, a large reservoir surrounded by rolling hills just before Shillong. Many people choose to pause here for a short break before continuing the drive, and over the years it has become a popular stopping point for private cars, Tempo Travellers and Urbania groups alike. Besides giving travellers a chance to stretch their legs, it also offers one of the first wide views of Meghalaya’s landscape.

The weather is also worth keeping in mind while planning the journey. Heavy rain during the monsoon can slow traffic on sections of the climb, while fog is fairly common on winter mornings closer to Shillong, and both can easily add extra time to the drive.

blocks.text: How to Book an Urbania in Guwahati?

content.text: We have a smooth process of booking an Urbania in Guwahati. We take enquiries over the phone, through WhatsApp on 06033114867 or through a booking form on our website.

If you’re booking via our website, the first step is usually to share the basic details of your trip, such as your name, email, the pickup and drop location, pickup date and time along with your phone number and the preferred vehicle type.

Once we have this information, we will usually check whether the vehicle is available for your preferred dates and recommend a vehicle that best suits your group size and the amount of luggage you will be carrying. This is also the right stage to mention any special requirements.

Before the payment is made, you will usually receive a written quotation. The booking is usually confirmed after an advance payment, which can be accepted through UPI, bank transfer or other common online payment methods.
If you are planning to travel during the peak tourist season, it is generally a good idea to book a few weeks ahead, as vehicle availability can become limited closer to your travel dates.

Kajaawa offers Urbania rentals in Guwahati for both one-way transfers and round trips. One-way bookings let the travellers continue onward from their destination, such as arriving in Guwahati and heading directly to Shillong or groups that only need transport for a single trip.

Round trips, on the other hand, are the more common choice for travellers, where the same vehicle and driver stay with the group for the entire journey. From the initial pickup in Guwahati through several destinations and back again.
For groups still finalising their travel plans, you can book any of the option that fits your travel plan. However, both the options with Kajaawa provides comfort and convenience to the travellers.

Our drivers are highly professional, couteous, friendly and familiar with the specific route being travelled, whether that is towards Shillong, the winding roads through Cherrapunji and Dawki or the considerably more demanding drive up to Tawang.

We generally carry out routine checks covering brakes, tyres and overall roadworthiness, along with a cleaning pass before the group boards. Features such as ABS and electronic stability control, along with other safety features available on the vehicle, are designed to help the driver maintain better control during sudden braking and on challenging roads.

Beyond the vehicle and the driver, our team at Kajaawa maintains ongoing coordination during the trip, through our operations contact 6033114867 that can be reached if plans need to change or an issue comes up along the way. For groups travelling with children, elderly members or anyone unfamiliar with hill roads, this additional support, together with a driver can make the journey feel more relaxed and reassuring.

blocks.text: Why Choose an Urbania in Guwahati?

content.text: For families and group of friends embarking on multi-destination journeys across the Northeast, the choice of vehicle can make a real difference to the overall travel experience. In this regard, our Urbania offers several advantages over more traditional options. Its higher seating position and large windows provide passengers with a better view of the changing landscape, especially on routes through the hills around Shillong or towards Kaziranga. The extra space is a major advantage for groups carrying more than the usual amount of luggage, while the comfortable seating and spacious cabin make long drives on uneven roads far more enjoyable.
✔Spacious cabin with comfortable seating, making long journeys across the Northeast much more enjoyable.
✔Higher seating position and large windows, giving passengers a better view of the changing scenery on hill routes.
✔Push-back seats and many Urbania rentals have features like USB charging points and individual reading lights for added comfort.
✔Available in multiple seating configurations, making it easy to choose an option that suits both your group size and luggage requirements.
✔Well suited for airport transfers, one-way journeys and multi-day road trips across Meghalaya, Assam and Arunachal Pradesh.
✔Plenty of luggage space, making it a practical choice for families, corporate groups and travellers carrying bags for longer holidays.
▶️Starting your journey early, especially if you are travelling on the Guwahati–Shillong route, often makes the drive more relaxed and can help you avoid heavier traffic along the way.

▶️It is also a good idea to carry a light jacket or some warm clothing, even if you are not travelling during the peak winter season, because the temperature can feel noticeably cooler once you leave the plains around Guwahati behind and begin climbing towards Shillong or other parts of Meghalaya.

▶️If your itinerary includes places in Arunachal Pradesh, including destinations like Tawang, checking the required permits well in advance can save a lot of unnecessary last minute hassle and help the journey go much more smoothly.

▶️It is always worth keeping a little flexibility in your daily plans while travelling through the hills, because weather, road conditions or even an unexpected stop at a beautiful viewpoint can sometimes change the day’s schedule.
▶️Carrying basic medication for motion sickness is a sensible precaution.
